title: Whetstone direction record (direction_record.jsonl)
description: The local, redacted referent of every direction_id. User-authored direction only; a model never receives this text in the slice.

prompt_association.description: how the direction was bound to the task: prompt_id (preferred), paired (UserPromptSubmit local capture), or ancestry (final transcript ancestry)

redacted_excerpt.description: exact user-authored text, secrets redacted before persistence

authorship.description: evidence: transcript record type=='user' AND isSidechain==false; model-expanded text is never eligible

provenance.description: Hash the EXACT bounded source records, never the whole growing transcript.

record_sha256.description: byte hash of the exact transcript record, not the whole file
